subject: Pilot credits & pricing request — AuroraEdge POC
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@auroraedge.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@auroraedge.com>, AuroraEdge Procurement <procurement@auroraedge.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 15:21:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot support: request for top-up credits & temporary rate adjustment

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited about the latency and cost profile you showed. We are ready to move forward with a 6-week PoC but need two things to bridge our internal approval: a small top-up of free credits to get through the integration (we exhausted the initial allotment during load testing) and a short-term price concession for sustained high-throughput evaluation (estimated 150k tokens/day peak).

Ask summary:
- One-time PoC credit top-up: 120,000 free generation tokens
- Temporary per-token rate adjustment for the PoC period (6 weeks) — request: 12% off list hosted rate

We’re aiming to get procurement sign-off by next Tuesday. I attached our current SOW draft and the expected traffic profile. If there’s an exec-friendly recommendation you can route to, that would help move this quickly.

Best,
Laura Chen
Head of Platform
AuroraEdge

Attachments:
- AuroraEdge_PoC_SOW_v0.9.pdf (application/pdf, 256 KB)

---
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@auroraedge.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@auroraedge.com>, AuroraEdge Procurement <procurement@auroraedge.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 18:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot support: request for top-up credits & temporary rate adjustment

Laura —

Appreciate the clarity and the SOW. We can support AuroraEdge on this, but the 12% promotional reduction plus 120k free tokens is outside standard self-serve allowances. I’ve copied Marissa (Sales Lead, EMEA/Enterprise) and Aditya (Head of Revenue Ops) to route for a one-off concession.

Proposed middle-ground from my side to present to execs: 
- Top-up: 100,000 generation tokens (one-time; covers expected integration spike)
- Promotional rate: 8% off hosted list for the 6-week PoC window, with requirement to convert to a paid Dedicated or commit before production
- We’ll include the performance SLO language in the term sheet (no SLA credit, just good-faith availability targets)

If AuroraEdge can confirm a short conversion signal (trial KPI: 3x baseline throughput within 30 days) and attach a clear decision owner in procurement, I’ll request expedited exec review.

Will follow up internally and loop you back once I have signoff.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Pilot support: request for top-up credits & temporary rate adjustment — exec review request

Aditya —

Forwarding Vivek and AuroraEdge’s ask. Quick summary and recommendation below.

External ask:
- 120k free tokens (AuroraEdge requested)
- 12% off hosted list for a 6-week PoC

Context:
- AuroraEdge is a Series C infrastructure customer (data platform) with clear potential to scale to a Dedicated contract in H1; VP of Engs committed to a formal evaluation and there are clear technical blockers our runtime helped with (KV caching reduced latency in their tests).
- Vivek proposes 100k tokens + 8% discount for 6 weeks tied to conversion signal. We’re being asked to accelerate procurement approval by next Tue.

Financial impact & guardrails:
- 100k tokens + 8% for 6 weeks is estimated at ~$9.5k in gross service margin impact if they convert then; cost of missing this account (large enterprise pipeline) is far greater.
- Proposed guardrail: discount applies only to hosted workload churn during PoC window and expires on the end date; credit is one-time and not refundable. Require a procurement contact and signed SOW amendment before credits apply.

Attachments for your review: redwood_custom_term_sheet.xlsx (proposed concession clause, timeline), revenue_impact_estimate_Q4.pdf (internal)

Ask: Can you approve 100k tokens + up to 8% hosted promo for 6 weeks and authorize Vivek to proceed with procurement and SOW amendment? If you want me to tighten the conversion clause or shorten discount window to 4 weeks, I can update the term sheet immediately.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments (referenced):
- redwood_custom_term_sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet with concession lines)
- revenue_impact_estimate_Q4.pdf (internal estimate)

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot support: request for top-up credits & temporary rate adjustment — exec review request

Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks for the concise note and the modeling. I’m comfortable approving the concession with the following binding conditions (please confirm in the SOW amendment before we apply credits):

Approved concession:
- One-time PoC credit top-up: 100,000 generation tokens
- Promo: 8% off hosted list rate for the 6-week PoC period

Binding conditions:
1) AuroraEdge must sign the SOW amendment (attached) and identify a named procurement approver by COB Monday (06 Dec 2027).
2) Discount applies only to the PoC tenant and expires automatically at the end of the 6-week window.
3) Credits are non-refundable and will be applied only after the SOW amendment is countersigned and the PoC billing account is provisioned.
4) If AuroraEdge has not issued a formal commitment signal within 45 days after PoC end, we reserve the right to retract special pricing; we will notify them 14 days in advance.

Marissa/Vivek: please update the term sheet with the above language and send to Laura + procurement. Vivek — you can share the approved concession with AuroraEdge and instruct them on next steps.

- Aditya
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
